initial_spec.task: Classify KCNQ1 pore-region variant p.Ala341Val under conflicting evidence.
initial_assumptions: Automated patch-clamp assay in CHO cells showed normal current density (BS3)

evidence_schedule.content: VCEP Rule: In silico predictions cannot be used to overrule electrophysiology assays (PP3 and BP4 downweighted).
Residue 341 resides within the pore helix (hotspot PM1). All known missense variants at this position cause LQTS.

ASSAY REVERSAL: CHO cell assay was defective due to lack of KCNE1 beta-subunit. Co-expression assay with KCNE1 shows severe loss of I_Ks current and dominant negative suppression. Invalidates BS3 and triggers PS3!
International LQTS registry publishes cosegregation in 12 families with QTc > 480ms and syncope (PS4).

ground_truth.provenance: Pore helix mutation reclassified to Pathogenic once physiologic beta-subunit assay performed.
